versions.name: 2026-09-12-baseline
versions.note: The kit as measured for the v0.1.0 build path, with the presentation look of docs/presentation-look.md. Pinned for the builder, the critic and the version pictures.

versions.name: 2026-09-12-v1
versions.note: Trees rebuilt without a library (a trunk forking into arching limbs, branches and twigs, leaf-cluster cards), bushes and hedges as a dark core with a shell of outward-facing cards, the high-performance GPU hint, __house.stats and __house.gl. Not pinned: the build path keeps the baseline until the kit v2 measured run.

versions.name: 2026-09-13-v2
versions.note: v1's trees with the bushes and hedges as thick shells of single outward-facing leaves over a dark core (the leaf-ball look). The presentation look is still the calibrated one of docs/presentation-look.md: the reference the light design pass in dev is compared with. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-09-13-v3
versions.note: v2 plus the light design pass on the presentation look: a stronger warmer sun, less sky fill, a near-neutral hemisphere, a graded meadow beyond the plot with a hole under the terrain (pools and sunken things show again), a touch of contrast and saturation at the end. The sky is still the analytic one: the reference the HDRI sky in dev is compared with. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-09-17-v4
versions.note: v3 with the land beyond the plot fixed: a sheet with a hole under every mesh tagged terrain (not only the first) that follows the scene's groundY for 40 m past the plot before easing to a far height, instead of one flat disc clamped to the terrain's highest point, which buried the lower villas of a sloped three-house project whose scene had a 2000 m context terrain. house.js unchanged from v3. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-09-23-v5
versions.note: v4 plus textured surfaces (Poly Haven finishes at their real size, tinted to the colour asked for: render, roof tiles on sloped roofs, lawn, gravel, asphalt, wood, concrete) and the interior modules: rooms and partitions (interior.js), furniture (furnish.js), finishes (finishes.js), the first-person walk (walk.js, ?walk=1 or the viewer's Walk button). The viewer's default. Not pinned. Since 2026-09-24 also the 2D plan (plan2d.js: the viewer's Plan dialog, __house.plan2d). Since 2026-09-25 also the real surroundings on presentation pages (context.js, ?context=, #39) and __house.setCamera.

versions.name: 2026-09-25-v6
versions.note: v5 plus the real far landscape with the surroundings (the relief to 80 km with its aerial photos, the Earth's curvature, drawn pulled in toward the camera, hazed into the sky's own horizon colour: the lake, the Alps, the Jura), generic windows and doors on the neighbours, a livelier ground up close, the plot's edge sunk instead of cut (no gap), and the sky's clouds from a mask computed at build time (kit/sky/v6: no blocks, no grain). The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-09-25-v7
versions.note: v6 with the far landscape recalibrated against photographs of the Alps from Lausanne (aerial perspective mixed as the screen shows it: slate-blue mountains, hue 215, saturation 0.26, where v6 drew them ultramarine; its own shading, rock on steep slopes; a finer relief once the surroundings are fetched again), the neighbours' renders varied (a Swiss palette), their foot darker, larger windows, shutters on some, a 5 m join to the plot (no bank tilting the roads), and no dithered rim. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-09-27-v8
versions.note: v7 plus the indoor light of #41 in walk mode: each room lit by its own light (captured from inside it, every room of a storey on arrival), one exposure per storey set for its brighter rooms with a little adaptation per room, the light and exposure of two rooms mixed across their doors and open passages (no switch at the threshold); live mirrors (mirror.js: the mirror most in view reflects its room and the rooms its doors open onto); the sun's shadow drawn once instead of every frame (walk frames about 3x faster, pictures unchanged). The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-04-v9
versions.note: v8 with the lamps chosen by what the camera sees: above the six live lights, the stand-ins go to the lamps of the rooms in view (the camera's room and the rooms open to it, less for a room through a door), ranked by intensity, distance and being in front, instead of the six nearest in a straight line (lamps of the other storeys and behind walls, which lit the room through the slabs); a lamp fades in and out instead of switching; each room's probe is captured with its own lamps at the indoor strength, and the exposure meter recalibrated for it (in_meter 0.5). The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v10
versions.note: v9 with the walk's motion of the reference tour (#53): a glide keeps to the middle of doors and passages, rounds its corners, speeds up and slows down (2 m/s², slower in sharp corners, 2.2 m/s at most, 1.5 s at least), looks a little ahead along its path, eases out of its start heading and into the arrival one (__house.walkTo(x, z, { yaw, pitch })) and levels the view; the keys speed up in 0.5 s (1.1 m/s, Shift runs) and stop in 0.17 s, the arrow keys ease their turn, the mouse look is smoothed. Pictures unchanged. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v11
versions.note: v10 with the glide's view turning no faster than 2.4 rad/s (#53): leaving the start heading while the path itself turned could add up to about 4 rad/s on a glide that starts facing away from its path (Montelly49-Dev4); the glide ends once the view has reached its arrival heading. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v12
versions.note: v11 with the room viewpoints (#54): arriving in a room (Walk, Go to a room, the room-N views) stands where a photographer would, from a corner or the doorway (the threshold for a small room), level, eye 1.45 m, the view chosen among the room's free spots and 32 headings for showing most of its floor with its windows, nothing near filling the frame and the view ending on the room's own walls (or the rooms open to it); a room's `view: { at, look }` in its floor plan, or a `room-<n>` view the scene returns, is taken instead. __house.viewpoint reports it. Waiting for review: not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v13
versions.note: v12 with the walk going from room to room (#55): the viewer's "Go to a room" walks there (a glide to the room's viewpoint) on the same storey and flat when it takes at most 6 s, else it fades to black and back (0.3 s each way), behind which the walk changes storey; a storey's grids and viewpoints are kept, so going back is at once. Entering the walk fades too, behind which every material is compiled for the indoor light and drawn once (no compile mid-glide). The effects guard no longer switches the effects off for one slow frame (a compile, an upload, the driver's first draw): three in a row over 250 ms or eight averaging over 90 ms. __house.goToRoom. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v14
versions.note: v13 with the guided tour (#57): the rooms one flat after the other, storey by storey, the hall and the day rooms first, then the nearest (storage and stairs skipped), a glide or a fade to each room's viewpoint and a 3 s pause; any key, click or wheel stops it; ?tour=1 or #autoplay starts it once loaded, house:tour from the viewer (its Tour button) too. The effects guard skips every frame while a fade is not clear and judges the median of eight frames. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v15
versions.note: v14 with neutral whites indoors (#58): a room's white balance takes half of its colour cast out (in_wb=0.5: the mean colour of its middle tones, measured on its capture, luminance kept, linear gains before the tone mapping), blended across doors and eased like the exposure, neutral outdoors. The rooms read white instead of beige (median saturation 0.17 -> 0.08 on TestVillaGille, 0.15 -> 0.07 on Montelly49-Dev4), brightness unchanged, wood still warm. New knob in_probe_lamps (the lamps' share in the room captures, 1). Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v16
versions.note: v15 with the ambient occlusion's thickness at 0.3 m indoors (1 outdoors): a door leaf 0.6 m from the camera drew a large bright arc over the room behind it (the WC of TestVillaGille's App. 1 seen from its doorway, a #54 viewpoint). Shadows a touch lighter (p10 132 -> 139), the rest unchanged. Knob in_ao_thickness. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v17
versions.note: v16 with walk frames about a third cheaper (#56): the house's static meshes merged by room (or 16 m tile for the shell and the outside) and material when the walk starts (2,465 meshes into 363 on TestVillaGille, 90 ms; the meshes as built stay for the plan, the audit and the exports, on a layer no camera draws), the ambient occlusion reading the scene pass's depth instead of drawing the whole scene again for its normals, and the furniture of the rooms the camera cannot see (through the openings in view) left out. Draw calls per frame 1,440-4,320 -> 330-1,150; render cost 37 -> 23 ms (TestVillaGille), 29 -> 18 ms (Montelly49-Dev4); 60 fps when turning on the RTX 3050; pictures unchanged. Knobs ?merge=0, ?cull=0, ?ao_gbuffer=1, ?merge_tile=16, ?ao_samples. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v18
versions.note: v17 with glossy reflections projected on the room's box (#59): each room capture records the room's box and where it was captured from, and the 55 glossy materials of TestVillaGille (roughness under 0.5: tiles, worktops, lacquer, metal) correct their reflection vector on the box of the camera's room before reading it (parallax correction, off outdoors). No extra draw call, the frame time unchanged; the change is small on the test projects (no polished floors, 128 px captures). ?box=0: off. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v19
versions.note: v18 with the scene page reporting its load (#60: house:progress, the files fetched then the first frame being drawn, for the viewer's cover and progress) and its images (finishes, surroundings, the sky's clouds) decoded off the main thread while they download (ImageBitmap) instead of on the main thread at the first frame: TestVillaGille's first frame uploads its textures in 3.7 s instead of 4.8. Pictures unchanged. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v20
versions.note: v19 with the details a builder leaves out of its rooms (#43), added by the kit to every floor plan once the scene is built: skirting (6 cm, stopping at the doors, not on tiled walls), inner window sills, and a curtain rail over each window with curtains next to it; the photographer's view of a room (photo-<n>: the walk's viewpoint at 1.3 m, a 24 mm lens, level, the frame shifted down instead of tilted); and the dollhouse (#62): a storey from above with everything over its ceiling hidden, hovering names a room, a click walks into it (house:dollhouse, __house.dollhouse(i)). The audit also asks for curtains on the windows of living rooms and bedrooms and for something on their walls. Coats on the coat hooks shaped like coats (#44: a body narrowing to the collar, sleeves, folds) instead of two boxes. Built on v12 (under review): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v21
versions.note: v20 with interior finishes graded to sit together (#61): oak, oak-light, tile and tile-dark keep their names on less orange, more varied CC0 sets (Poly Haven laminate_floor_03, granite_tile) or drawn 60 x 60 porcelain tiles with a correction per finish (saturation, contrast, brightness, hue) applied to the colour map at load; new floors oak-smoked, herringbone, terrazzo, marble; terrazzo and marble worktops. Under review (#61): not the viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-09-v22
versions.note: v21 with a clean frame at rest (#56): once the camera stops, 8 frames with the camera jittered by a fraction of a pixel are averaged (anti-aliasing and the occlusion's noise converge within about 0.6 s; ?rest=0: off), and a fix to the walk's room culling: a mesh belonged to the first room whose storey band held it, so the ground floor's rugs, low tables, bed bases and furniture legs counted as the cellar's and vanished whenever the cellar was not drawn (since v17); now the room on the highest floor below. Also ceiling cornices for period houses (#43, floorPlan cornice: true) and ?framelog=1 (__house.frameLog, __house.culling) for diagnosing frames. The viewer's default since 2026-10-10 (#54 viewpoints, #58 whites and #61 finishes approved). Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-10-v23
versions.note: v22 with the SIA 416 quantities (#47, #48): kit/quantities.js reads the built scene (floor plans, exterior walls also when their kind was removed, window and door units, slabs, balconies, wall tiles, exterior works) and measures what is not tagged: a building's top seen from above and the underside of a roof seen from below (height maps drawn on the GPU, small parts left out, roof-window holes and the ridge joint closed by the roof's planes), the façades from the envelope's faces in their plane. The runtime answers house:quantities and __house.quantities() for the viewer's "Surfaces et volumes" dialog. Floor plans record each room's floor finish and whether the storey has a ceiling, wall tiles their bands, hedges, fences, pathways and ground patches their geometry; new room uses cellar, laundry, garage, attic, technical. Pictures unchanged. The viewer's default since 2026-10-10. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-10-v24
versions.note: v23 with the interior measured for the builder (#67, #68, #70): kit/layout.js checks every furniture piece of the floor plans and the rooms against the areas printed on the plan (more than 5 % and 0.5 m² off, with the likely cause; rooms with no plan area), windows blocked inside and outside, sizes unusual for a piece or its room, passages (80 cm between a room's doors, 60 cm beside a bed and in front of a sofa, 90 cm in front of a wardrobe, a kitchen run or an appliance, door swings), and supports (rays against the meshes: floating or sunk by more than 1 cm, overhanging, overlapping, wall-hung pieces more than 5 cm off the wall, through a wall or in no room). Its lines lead the scene audit (an interior's before the exterior's); __house.report() carries the full table for the builder's measure tool. Pictures unchanged. The viewer's default (the Furnish job draws with it). Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-11-v25
versions.note: v24 with the surroundings fixed (#65, #66): the builder's ground ends with its site (the house, the garden, its fences and hedges, plus 3 m), clipped there, and the real ground takes over beyond it, instead of a lawn drawn out to 85 m or a 350 m backdrop lying over the real land as a green square; the neighbours swissBUILDINGS3D lacks come from the newest lidar (geo/lidar.py, source "lidar" in buildings.json) and wear roof tiles or gravel, since the aerial photo shows a building site there. Interiors and the build path unchanged. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-11-v26
versions.note: v25 with the trees and bushes of the newest lidar in the surroundings (#50, #39 step 3): trees.json (geo/lidar.py: canopy height, tops, crowns, kind) placed in context.js, none on the builder's site; the 30 nearest within 35 m of it made branch by branch (leafTree, leafBush), the others copies of a few kit trees fitted to each tree with a quarter of their leaf cards, an eighth beyond 70 m (house.treeStand, a few draws); they thin out from 120 m to 135 m from the house. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-11-v27
versions.note: v26 with the ground by type near the house (#50, #39 step 4): the cadastral survey's land cover (cover.png from geo/landcover.py: asphalt, lawn, paving, gravel masks at 0.25 m) drawn in the kit's finishes on the surroundings' ground, each keeping its texture's detail with its colour moved toward the photo's there (all of it for a lawn, a third for asphalt), within 120 m of the house and fading into the photo over 15 m. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-11-v28
versions.note: v27 with the 3D radius per project and the surroundings' switch (#51, #50): the trees and the ground by type stop at the owner's radius around the house (alignment.near, 30 to 165 m, 120 by default), fading into the photo over 15 m; house:surroundings { mode: "3d" | "photo" } (the viewer's switch, also ?surroundings=photo and __house.setSurroundings) shows the aerial photo alone, the neighbours in 3D as before. The viewer's default. Not pinned.

versions.name: 2026-10-11-v29
versions.note: v28 with the sun study (#49) on presentation pages whose surroundings are aligned: sun.js (NOAA's solar position with SPA's refraction: within 0.005° and 2 s of NREL's SPA at Lausanne; Swiss time with summer time; LV95 to WGS84; the horizon profile of the far landscape), sunstudy.js (house:sun: the real sun for a Swiss date and hour, the shadow map over the 3D radius at 4096 px, the far relief as a horizon mask, the analytic sky baked again as the sun moves, the page's own sun back when it ends; house:sunHours: the hours of direct sun a day over the plot, for a day every 10 minutes or a season of 13 days a week apart every 20 minutes, accumulated on the GPU from the sun's own shadow map onto the surfaces seen from above, shown as a coloured map with hour lines). The viewer's default. Not pinned.
